actions.action: Check signs of root-bound (water drainage speed, circling roots, slowing growth, pot bulging)
Buy a pot 4-5cm larger in diameter with drainage holes
Buy chunky well-draining mix with perlite or orchid bark
Remove plant gently from pot, cutting pot or trimming stuck roots if needed
Inspect roots and trim black/mushy ones, loosen outer roots
Replant at same depth, fill in soil and water thoroughly
Keep in bright light and withhold fertilizer for 3-4 weeks
Optionally divide the plants, ensuring each piece has healthy roots and several stems

reason: The answer correctly identifies root-bound as the issue and recommends repotting one modest size up, which matches the fix that worked, with nothing harmful.
